title: The back porch, all three stories
intro: You picked A, the porch. Here are all three sample stories on the real homepage: the same porch at three times of day. Each painting appears when you click that person's name. Only the paintings change; the words stay. My score for the set: 9 / 10. What holds it back: all three share one view, so only the table changes from story to story, and the watercolour is softer than the Big Sur painting at the bottom of the page.

set.name: Lisa, “It fits into my mornings”
set.what: Morning: coffee, orange juice, oranges, poppies, a paper lunch bag and the car keys. The one you picked.

set.name: Michael, “I read up on it first”
set.what: Dusk: an open book and reading glasses on the arm of a wooden porch chair, a notebook, a pencil and a mug.

set.name: Susan, “The source mattered to me”
set.what: Afternoon: a piece of honeycomb on a board beside a sprig of the Brazilian shrub the bees take their resin from. (The first take had dark green resin on the comb that looked like mould up close; repainted clean.)
